page.layout: One blank page of paper, no printed text. Torn and stained edges at the right and lower right; dark background of the scan around the sheet.
page.notes: Blank leaf: no printed text, no running head, page number, catchword or signature. Only stains, a rust-coloured spot near the upper right, a small hole at the right edge, and paper damage at the corners. The dark area around the sheet is the scanning background, not part of the page.
